news.headline: Delcath Systems (DCTH) adopts new exclusive forum clauses in amended bylaws
Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management confirmed it will present at the Canaccord Genuity growth conference in Boston on August 11, 2026, part of a broader push to keep the stock in front of generalist and specialist healthcare investors following the Q2 beat.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $32 from $30, Reiterates Buy
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright lifted its price target on DCTH shares following the strong Q2 print, citing accelerating HEPZATO volumes and the raised full-year revenue outlook.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 20% year-over-year to $29.1M ($27.1M from HEPZATO KIT), gross margin expanded to 90%, and net income held at $2.7M; management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M and reaffirmed a target of 37 active U.S. treatment centers by year-end.

news.headline: BTIG Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $17 from $16, Maintains Buy
news.summary: BTIG nudged its price target higher ahead of Q2 earnings, pointing to continued HEPZATO commercial momentum and site-expansion progress.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in a new investigator-initiated Phase 2 study of HEPZATO in HER2-negative, liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer, extending the platform beyond uveal melanoma.

catalysts.label: US site network expansion
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for roughly six more HEPZATO treatment centers to go live, reaching 37 active US sites by year-end 2026 (31 active as of Q2), with 40 centers targeted by Q1 2027.

catalysts.label: FDA pre-IND meetings for new indications
catalysts.detail: Management plans pre-IND discussions with the FDA to pursue additional HEPZATO indications beyond uveal melanoma, building on early breast and colorectal cancer signal data.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 metastatic breast cancer trial enrollment
catalysts.detail: Investigator-initiated Phase 2 study of HEPZATO in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer is enrolling across six activated sites following the first patient dosed in July 2026; independent ESMO data previously showed hepatic partial responses in 9 of 15 pretreated patients.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 metastatic colorectal cancer trial
catalysts.detail: Sponsored Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO as add-on therapy in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer now has 13 centers actively screening across the US and Europe; primary endpoint results are anticipated around mid-2028.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next quarterly results and updated guidance/site-activation commentary are expected in the November 2026 reporting window (exact date not yet announced).

pulse: Delcath enters the back half of 2026 from a position of commercial strength: Q2 revenue jumped 20% year-over-year to $29.1M on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, prompting management to raise FY26 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M and triggering a round of analyst price-target increases (H.C. Wainwright to $32, BTIG to $17). The story is broadening beyond core uveal melanoma commercialization, with the US treatment-center network expanding toward 37 sites by year-end and newly dosed Phase 2 trials in metastatic breast and colorectal cancer signaling a push toward a multi-indication liver-directed therapy platform. Near-term catalysts are execution-driven (site activations, FDA pre-IND discussions on new indications) rather than binary regulatory events, with the next major data readout (colorectal primary endpoint) not expected until around 2028.
